question: Can an independently downloaded ESP-IDF firmware artifact be statically checked for provenance, hashes and flash/partition layout before a physical flash?

Static SHA-256 and header checks cannot prove firmware authenticity, source-to-binary determinism, board compatibility, or flashed bytes.
